author: Lynder063
title: Ratchet & Clank reaches 100% matched
description: The first Ratchet & Clank is now fully matched, Going Commando climbs to 84.74%, and launcher 0.10.0 is out.
headline: Ratchet & Clank reaches 100% matched, and Going Commando climbs to 84.74%
summary: The first game is now fully matched: its last 11 functions landed this week (rac1-decomp#135), so all of its code compiles to the same bytes as the original. Going Commando's matched code rose from 14.04% to 84.74%, driven by large batches such as 780 functions (rac2-decomp#333) and 453 more (rac2-decomp#384). Deadlocked moved from 4.54% to 6.07%. The launcher released version 0.10.0, and its development line gained a signed mod list with one-click install links (OpenRAC#161). Development work also added safer starts after a crash (OpenRAC#131) and Android 9 support (OpenRAC#77).

rac1-decomp.headline: All 5,116 functions matched
rac1-decomp.summary: Ratchet & Clank went from 98.48% to 100.00% of code matched. The last 11 functions landed in #135. Work has since moved to tidying the source without changing the game.
highlights: Counting fix: three ported overlay functions are now counted correctly (#128).
Cleanup: the last private pause menu views were converted (#185).

rac2-decomp.headline: Matched code rises from 14.04% to 84.74%
rac2-decomp.summary: Matched functions went from 4,351 to 7,760 of about 8,600. The largest batches matched 780 functions (#333) and 453 functions (#384), and #386 took the USA release to 84.6%.
highlights: Other releases: #386 also reports USA v2.00 at 80.9% and PAL at 54.1%.

rac3-decomp.headline: Native front-end routines added
rac3-decomp.summary: Up Your Arsenal added native front-end routines with NTSC validation (#1). Its code figure stayed at 8.72%.

rac4-decomp.headline: Code matching rises from 4.54% to 6.07%
rac4-decomp.summary: Deadlocked merged many small batches of matched PAL functions, including 274 runtime and library functions (#40) and 276 more in another batch (#46). The figure the site shows is for NTSC-U.

OpenRAC.headline: Launcher 0.10.0, and mods with one-click install in development
OpenRAC.summary: Launcher 0.10.0 was released this week. Separately, the development line gained a signed mod list, install links, dependencies and automatic updates (#161), which reach players in a later release.
highlights: Safer starts: Safe rendering turns on after a crashed start (#131).
More devices: Android 9 support was added (#77).
Smoother play: a more precise frame limiter (#146) and optional low-latency frames (#122).
Steam: the launcher can add itself to Steam, with its pictures (#184).
Reported problems: players hit failures preparing Enhanced Graphics (#141, #173) and asked for controller remapping (#135).

openrac-mods.headline: A signed mod list and Archipelago support
openrac-mods.summary: The mods repository gained a signed index and submission bot (#7) and Archipelago multiworld support (#5).
highlights: Openness: each mod's listing now states whether AI helped make it (#33).
